component.name: LibreCelik
component.summary: Read smart cards and sign documents with them

description.p: LibreCelik reads Serbian government smart cards — identity, vehicle and health — as well as generic ICAO electronic travel documents, NIST PIV cards and PKCS#15 cards. It talks to the reader through the LibreSCRS agent, so the PIN is collected by the agent's own prompter rather than inside the application.
It also signs documents: PAdES, XAdES and CAdES, at the long-term levels as well as the basic ones, with a visible signature on a PDF page when one is wanted.
